Maya (Product): Quick sync — we need to lock the SDK RFC for streaming+retry before roadmap sign-off tomorrow. Summarize scope and acceptance criteria here please. @Samir @Ada :eyes:
Samir (Eng): Suggest minimal surface: streaming client with built-in reconnect, per-chunk backoff, and tail-call error semantics. Keep API tiny: `stream.start(opts)` with `retryStrategy` enum.
Ada (DevEx): +1 for small surface. Customers ask for easy opt-in optimistic retries (no double side-effects). Need guidance on idempotency and user-provided idempotency keys.
Chris (Platform): Important: platform metrics must show per-request retry count, latency p50/p95 with/without retries, and failure mode tags. We'll need standardized headers for tracing.
Jenna (PM): Launch criteria: doc + SDK tests, 2 customer beta signups, e2e bench under 250ms p95 for common payloads, and migration guide. Any objections?
Samir (Eng): Edge cases: streaming resume when model variant changes mid-stream, partial responses, client cancel during reconnect, auth token refresh during backoff.
Ada (DevEx): Acceptance criteria bullets: 1) ergonomic API with single-line opt-in 2) default safe retry policy (no automatic re-send of non-idempotent calls) 3) CI tests for reconnect+resume 4) doc examples for server-side idempotency keys.
Maya (Product): Customers pushing: FinTech customer needs guaranteed-at-most-once semantics unless idempotency key set, Enterprise wants telemetry retention 90d for incidents.
Samir (Eng): Implementation plan: 1) RFC PR with API surface + opt-in flags 2) reference impl in JS + Go 3) canary for beta orgs 4) rollback plan via feature flag. Code sketch:
```
// streaming client sketch
const c = new Redwood.StreamClient({
  retryStrategy: 'prefix-aware', // 'none'|'simple'|'prefix-aware'
  idempotencyKey: null, // user supplied
  connectTimeoutMs: 5000,
})
for await (const chunk of c.stream(prompt)) {
  // handle
}
```
Ada (DevEx): Docs note: show migration path for existing blocking calls -> streaming; sample tests for flaky networks. Also include small snippet for server idempotency header: `x-redwood-idempotency: <uuid>`.
Chris (Platform): Ops: add rollout checklist — SLOs verified in staging, alert if retry rate > 5% or 5xx during retry > 0.5%, and ensure we can flip to non-retry mode instantly.
Jenna (PM): Prioritization: rank as "high" for devex roadmap if we can ship JS first, then Go. Timebox to 4 sprints? Product approves 2-sprint fasttrack if eng agrees.
Samir (Eng): 2 sprints is tight but doable if we scope minimal: JS-only, single retry strategy, no cross-model resume; others in later RFC.
Maya (Product): Decision: fasttrack minimum viable SDK retry streaming for JS. Action items: Samir open RFC by EOD, Ada draft docs + examples by Wed, Chris prep metrics + rollout playbook, Jenna run outreach to 3 beta customers. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: staging feature-flag gym-toggle at 2027-01-18T09:30:00Z
Maya (Product): Thanks all — I'll capture in the PRD and ping reviewers. If nobody objects within 2h I'll merge the decision and tag owners.
